Participate is the third WHAT skill. Bring yourself fully into what you are doing instead of standing outside the experience and judging each step.

## Participate {#participate}

Practise joining the moment with attention, adjusting when observation or description is needed, and then returning to full participation.
## Source / Printable Copy

[Participate source page](/resources/mindfulness/mindfulness-participate-source.pdf)

## Text Version / Adapted Text

Participate means entering the current activity fully enough to do it, rather than watching yourself from a distance or rehearsing every move. Let attention return to the activity and respond to what is actually happening.
